subject.title: feat: add runtime self context config and tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `runtimeContext` and the model-facing `runtime` tool as permanent core contracts, and which proposed v1 fields are stable enough to support now?
rationale: The branch exposes forward-looking provider, action, offload, cost, freshness, and provenance structures whose long-term ownership and compatibility cannot be decided from patch correctness alone.

options.title: Approve a narrower v1
options.body: Keep only implemented runtime identity, resource, and read-only freshness fields while deferring speculative provider, action, offload, and cost contracts.

options.title: Approve the full v1
options.body: Accept the complete proposed configuration and tool schemas as supported foundations for later implementations.

options.title: Pause for combined design
options.body: Hold this PR until runtime self-context and the linked execution-placement contract are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrower v1
recommendation.body: Keep only implemented runtime identity, resource, and read-only freshness fields while deferring speculative provider, action, offload, and cost contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history connects this person to the exact runtime-context, prompt/session, and core-tool boundaries affected by the decision.
